summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EcoAndes Batch 6 features: splash screen, hero carousel indicators, recipes section, admin recipes/files pages, external files API, and abandoned cart 2nd reminder. All core functionality working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Email send fails with test email addresses (example.com domain)
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior - Resend API rejects test domains. Core logic works correctly (cart state updated, reminder2_sent_at set, reminder_count=2)

passed_tests: Splash screen appears on first load with video (webm fallback in test Chromium)
Splash skip button closes screen and sets sessionStorage
Splash does NOT reappear on subsequent navigation (session-based)
Hero carousel dots positioned on RIGHT side vertically (desktop: 98.2%, mobile: 96.2%)
Hero dots clickable and change slides
Recipes section visible on home after featured products with 1 active video
GET /api/recipes returns active recipes (public endpoint)
GET /api/recipes/admin requires authentication (401 without token)
GET /api/recipes/admin returns all recipes with auth
PUT /api/recipes/admin saves and restores recipe list
POST /api/admin/files/external requires authentication
POST /api/admin/files/external rejects invalid URLs (400)
POST /api/admin/files/external adds external file with external:true flag
GET /api/admin/files?kind=video filters video files correctly
DELETE /api/admin/files/{id} removes external file
Abandoned cart 2nd reminder logic: cart updated with reminder2_sent_at and reminder_count=2
Abandoned cart 2nd reminder is idempotent (no duplicate sends)
Admin recipes page loads with add/save/up/down/delete buttons
Admin files page loads with 'Add by link' button
Admin files 'Add by link' dialog opens with input field
Admin files video filter tab exists and works
Shop page loads with 696 products
Cart page loads without errors
Admin dashboard accessible after login

success_percentage.backend: 100% (9/9 tests - 1 event loop cleanup issue is non-functional)

detailed_notes.splash_screen: Works perfectly - appears once per session using sessionStorage 'eco_splash_seen', video uses webm fallback in test Chromium (H.264 not supported), skip button works, auto-close at 11s max
detailed_notes.hero_carousel: Dots correctly positioned on right side vertically for both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390x844px). Desktop dots at 98.2% of viewport width, mobile at 96.2%. Height > width confirms vertical arrangement.
detailed_notes.recipes_section: Visible on home page after featured products section, displays 1 active recipe video with title 'Receta demo'. Video element renders correctly.
detailed_notes.recipes_api: All endpoints working: public GET returns active items, admin GET requires auth, PUT saves/restores list correctly
detailed_notes.external_files_api: Complete functionality: auth required, invalid URLs rejected, external files added with external:true flag, video filter works, deletion works
detailed_notes.abandoned_carts_2nd_reminder: Core business logic verified: test cart created with status 'reminded' and updated_at 25h ago, process_abandoned_carts() correctly identified it, updated reminder2_sent_at and reminder_count to 2, second run sent 0 reminders (idempotent). Email send failure is EXPECTED (Resend rejects example.com test domains).
detailed_notes.admin_pages: Both /admin/recetas and /admin/archivos load correctly with all expected UI elements and functionality
detailed_notes.regression: All tested pages (home, shop, cart, admin) load without errors
